description: A disciplined martial goblinoid with a controlled soldierly bearing, more organized and sturdier than a goblin but not orc-like. Lean athletic humanoid with balanced proportions and trained posture rather than oversized muscles. Mostly smooth skin with sparse scars; armor surfaces kept broad and simple.
